title.zh: 全屋智能设备无感出海方案：电视盒子（Apple TV / Android TV）、PS5 / Switch 游戏机全局加速
title.en: Whole-Home Smart Device Proxying: Seamless Apple TV, Android TV, PS5 & Nintendo Switch Acceleration

cluster.zh: 路由器固件与家庭网关

description.zh: 针对电视盒子与次世代主机游戏的无感网络加速解决方案。详解 Apple TV 4K 配合 Surge / Quantumult X 或旁路由解锁 Netflix 4K HDR、PS5 与 Nintendo Switch 外服联机 NAT Type 优化实战。
description.en: Comprehensive acceleration playbook for smart living room devices and consoles. Learn how to configure Apple TV 4K with tvOS Surge/Quantumult X or side-gateways for Netflix 4K HDR, and achieve NAT Type A/B on PS5 and Nintendo Switch.
